<ins>Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯)</ins> and <ins>Four Substances Decoction (四物湯)</ins> (both are found under injury with bleeding, 傷損出血)
<ins>Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯)</ins> (the formula is found under oppression and pain of the chest and abdomen, 胸腹痛悶)
<ins>Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯)</ins> and <ins>Ten Complete Great Supplementation Decoction (十全大補湯)</ins> (both are found under diffusion and settling of stagnant blood, 瘀血泛注)
